meaning: The red warning indicates a brake system fault. Read the accompanying message; this is not the normal parking brake confirmation.
action: Stop safely. Do not continue driving and obtain professional assistance. Topping up fluid does not repair the cause of fluid loss.
note: Only the listed versions and equipment are covered. Follow the exact message and your vehicle’s manual.

meaning: Flashing indicates that stability or traction control is intervening. It does not by itself indicate a fault.
action: Adapt speed and driving style to available grip and traffic conditions. The system cannot overcome physical limits.
note: Only the listed versions and equipment are covered. Follow the exact message and your vehicle’s manual.

meaning: The warning indicates insufficient engine oil pressure. A correct oil level alone does not confirm adequate lubrication pressure.
action: Stop safely and switch off the engine. Do not leave it idling. Further steps, including any restart, must follow the specific vehicle manual; if unsure, obtain professional assistance.
note: Do not confuse this with a yellow oil level warning. The source describes a conditional procedure after topping up; this is not general permission to restart.

action: Remain ready to brake. The system cannot hold the vehicle under all conditions; secure it properly before leaving.
note: Only the specified versions with a hold assistant. Not red parking-brake confirmation, white assistant deactivation or the separate transmission-position P.
alt: Hold assist – vehicle held (green P)

name: Direct tyre-pressure monitoring – low pressure
meaning: In the specified direct system, a steady amber tyre with exclamation mark can indicate pressure below the stored reference. The accompanying message determines the exact meaning.
action: Check all tyres and correct pressure to the specified values at the next safe opportunity. Store correct reference values only after checking; stored values do not themselves prove compliance with the manufacturer’s specification.
note: Only equipment with direct wheel pressure/temperature sensors. The same symbol with “Reifenpanne!” or “Radwechsel erkannt” has a different meaning. Do not transfer the procedure to indirect monitoring. In the direct system’s numerical display, green means approximately matching the stored reference, amber low pressure and red substantially low pressure. Dashes while stationary or learning are not measured pressure. Check tyre pressure at the appropriate temperature according to the manual; releasing air from hot tyres is not a general procedure.
alt: Direct tyre-pressure monitoring – low pressure

meaning: The symbol together with the explicit puncture message indicates critically low pressure relative to the stored reference. Amber alone is not permission to continue.
action: Avoid unnecessary abrupt steering and braking. Stop safely at the next opportunity and inspect the tyres. Actual condition and the manual determine whether further travel is possible; do not merely reset the warning.
note: Applies to the exact “Reifenpanne! Fahrzeug sicher abstellen. Bitte alle Reifen prüfen und im MMI speichern” message with the specified direct system. The symbol alone establishes neither damage extent nor a safe remaining range. In the direct system’s numerical display, green means approximately matching the stored reference, amber low pressure and red substantially low pressure. Dashes while stationary or learning are not measured pressure. Check tyre pressure at the appropriate temperature according to the manual; releasing air from hot tyres is not a general procedure.
